title: unicode-bidi: plaintext skips worker Claude screens
notes: From #232: index.css:43 body *:not(.pane, .pane *) { unicode-bidi: plaintext } excludes the whole .pane, so a worker's Claude screen, which sits inside .pane, does not get it. Persian or Arabic prose there can lay out wrong while main's screen is right. Same fix as #232's scrollbar: exclude only .xterm, not the pane. CSS only; hand check with a Persian line in a worker screen.

comments.body: PR #263: unicode-bidi plaintext now excludes only .xterm, not the whole pane, so a worker's Claude screen gets it. Hand check with a Persian line still to do.
